messages.subject: Typo in Titan.R
parts:
There appears to be a typo in the Titan.R file.  

loadAlleleCounts(...) should be loadAlleleCountsFromFile(...)

messages.author: 71cefeaaa3659875
messages.subject: Re: Typo in Titan.R
parts:
Hi Ryan,

TitanCNA v1.0.0 uses loadAlleleCountsFromFile(...) but in v1.2.0 or higher, this has been changed to loadAlleleCounts(...) because it can optionally load from a data.frame as well.

TitanRunner v0.1.1 or higher (which is compatible with TitanCNA R package v1.2.1+) reflects this change.

You should try to obtain the latest version of TitanCNA (v1.3.0) using the instructions found here:
http://compbio.bccrc.ca/software/titan/titan-installation/
See Step 3ii.

Thank you for your interest in TitanCNA.
Gavin
